title: ePI Validator Policy Pack Descriptor
description: Authoring reference for policy-packs/<id>.yaml. Enforcement is programmatic at startup (PolicyPackLoader + PolicyEngine fail fast); this schema documents the contract for pack authors.

id.description: Pack id; must equal the file name (policy-packs/<id>.yaml)

version.description: Semantic version of the pack; echoed in every validation audit block

appliesTo.description: IG configuration ids this pack applies to; every entry must match a configured IG

ruleId.description: Stable rule identifier; must have a registered PolicyRule implementation

configurable.description: Whether deployments may downgrade/disable this rule in a derived pack

rationale.description: Why this rule exists — echoed on every violation for reviewers and the repair agent
